name: H-CUE-WIGNER-SURMISE-GUE-SYNTHESIS
domain: Circular Unitary Ensemble & Wigner-Surmise Montgomery-Odlyzko GUE Exact Convergence

hypotheses.description: GUE Quadratic Spacing Repulsion: The nearest-neighbor spacing distribution p(s) of CUE(N) eigenphases on the circle strictly follows the GUE Wigner Surmise p(s) = (32/pi^2) * s^2 * exp(-4*s^2 / pi), with empirical fraction P(s < 0.2) <= 0.02 (ruling out Poisson P_Poisson(s < 0.2) = 0.1813).

Global Wigner-GUE Spacing Convergence: The root-mean-square deviation between empirical spacing density p(s) and Wigner-GUE distribution is strictly less than 20% of the Poisson deviation: RMSD(GUE) / RMSD(Poisson) <= 0.20 across all tested dimensions.

Spectral Form Factor Universal Ramp: The spectral form factor K(tau) of CUE(N) displays the exact linear GUE ramp K(tau) approx tau for tau in [0.05, 0.8], with correlation hole min_{tau in (0, 0.4)} K(tau) <= 0.10.

Quantum Hardware Frobenius-Interferometer Fidelity: On real quantum hardware (ibm_fez), mapping the CUE/Frobenius eigenphase difference onto a 2-qubit phase interferometer reproduces theoretical quantum state projections with fidelity >= 95.0%.

methodology.computation: Statevector & High-Dimensional Unitary Haar measure on CUE(N)
methodology.spacings: Circular nearest-neighbor phase distances normalized by mean density N/(2*pi)
methodology.qpu_usage: Hardware confirmation referenced from verified ibm_fez runs (Exp 067/063)
